description: FastAPI router module for handling test-related API endpoints, including starting, stopping, and retrieving status of tests, utilizing a TestsService for business logic.

classes.name: TestsService
classes.description: Service class handling test operations such as start, stop, and get_status.

methods.name: _get_service
methods.description: Retrieves the singleton instance of TestsService, raises RuntimeError if not initialized.

methods.name: set_tests_service
methods.description: Sets the singleton instance of TestsService used by the router.

methods.name: start_test
methods.description: API endpoint to start a test run, returns an envelope with the test run ID.

methods.name: stop_test
methods.description: API endpoint to stop a test run, returns an envelope with the test run ID.

methods.name: get_test_status
methods.description: API endpoint to retrieve the current status of a test run by UUID.
